cases.prompt: Support adding a tag to a bookmark. Use python cli.py bookmark tag ID TAG.
Support importing contacts from CSV. Use python cli.py contacts import FILE.
Support recording an expense. Use python cli.py expense add AMOUNT NOTE.
Support transferring inventory between locations. Use python cli.py inventory transfer ITEM FROM TO QUANTITY.
Support setting a feature flag. Use python cli.py flag set ENV NAME VALUE.
Support moving a track within a playlist. Use python cli.py playlist move ID POSITION.
Support merging a named configuration overlay. Use python cli.py config merge NAME.
Support creating a reminder. Use python cli.py reminder add TEXT DUE.
Support cancelling an order. Use python cli.py order cancel ID REASON.

mutation_intents.label: Fidelity repair
mutation_intents.directive: Repair train root causes within interviewer authority. Maximize explicit material-decision coverage and exact authority-to-contract projection while preserving useful parent behavior.

mutation_intents.label: Question compression
mutation_intents.directive: Reduce material-decision count and interaction burden without losing contract-changing coverage. Bundle only independent decisions and avoid speculative questions.

mutation_intents.label: Interaction redesign
mutation_intents.directive: Change the interview architecture, including ordering, grouping, recommendation strategy, and termination logic, rather than merely rewording the parent. Preserve runtime schemas.

mutation_intents.label: Novel structure
mutation_intents.directive: Create a substantially different compact elicitation and synthesis structure. Do not copy the parent organization unless it is essential to runtime correctness.
